overview: MTT Shipping and Logistics Berhad (MTTSL) 于2026年完成首次公开募股（IPO），发行633,500,000股新股并在Bursa Malaysia主板上市。公司宣布派发首次免税中期股息每股3.2仙。此外，公司进行了 recurrent related party transactions 的股东批准。
overview_en: MTT Shipping and Logistics Berhad (MTTSL) completed its initial public offering (IPO) in 2026, issuing 633,500,000 new ordinary shares and listing on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia. The company declared a first tax-exempt interim dividend of 3.2 sen per ordinary share. Additionally, the company obtained shareholders' ratification for recurrent related party transactions.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成IPO并在Bursa Malaysia主板上市，同时宣布首次中期股息。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026, and declared its first interim dividend.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED SHAREHOLDERS' RATIFICATION AND PROPOSED NEW SHAREHOLDERS' MANDATE FOR RECURRENT RELATED
actions.text: 公司向股东发出通函，寻求批准 recurrent related party transactions 及新的股东授权。
actions.text_en: The company issued a circular to shareholders seeking ratification and a new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions.

actions.title: MTTSL - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 公司宣布首次免税中期股息每股3.2仙，除权日为2026年9月7日，派发日为2026年9月23日。
actions.text_en: The company declared a first tax-exempt interim dividend of 3.2 sen per ordinary share, with ex-date on 7 September 2026 and payment date on 23 September 2026.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") OF 633,500,000 NEW ORDINARY SHARES IN MTT SHIPPING AND LOGISTICS BERHAD ("MTTSL" OR "COMPANY") ("IPO SHARES"
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股（IPO），发行633,500,000股新股，并在Bursa Malaysia主板上市。
actions.text_en: The company conducted an initial public offering (IPO) of 633,500,000 new ordinary shares and listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia.
